headline: Dangote Petroleum Refinery Closes Initial Public Offering
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery closed its major public offering, drawing investment applications from institutional and individual investors across 120 countries.
why: The Dangote Refinery is Africa's largest single-train crude refinery, and its public listing represents one of West Africa's biggest corporate equity transactions.

impacts.name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery
impacts.why: Successful closing of the equity offering broadens the company's shareholder base and capital structure.
